Laundry returning with brown stains, pubic hair, and or reeking of ripe urine. Broken toilets that either wont flush or repeatedly explode in Cells! | | | [](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zv1p8rd7ti4dljjgpnh8sk7prcqrdqr7thpus5so_rp22sh2s8i66or5c3gm6o35cjh2bs)
---
| | |
---
| | [](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zlh1mivn6msiq8k3f8ds38rmbpb3v3h8gd6jsoh8_rp22sh2s8i66or5c3gm6o35cjh2bs) Hi Patriot,

[Please give a crucial $10, $25, $50, $100, or more IMMEDIATELY to fully fund my two critical, class action lawsuits and hard-hitting legal actions to FREE ALL JANUARY 6 PROTESTERS!](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2z5h7ejtor5jcsdrt5tp1ik3be1riljgig91kc7ig_rp22sh2s8i66or5c3gm6o35cjh2bs)

I just read the urgent letter signed by 34 innocent Americans, jailed in Washington, D.C for peacefully protesting the stolen 2020 presidential election.

**Patriot, what’s being done to them is so demonic, so foul, that they’re BEGGING to be transferred to Guantanamo Bay, Cuba...where vicious, America-hating terrorists get better treatment!**

I’m heartsick and deeply angry about what’s being done to our fellow patriots.

Their letter reads like an appeal from dissidents in the Soviet Union.

Here are just a few examples of what they’re enduring (I quote directly from their letter, published by Gateway Pundit):

* Begging for Help / Water / Medical Aid / Mercy through a 4-inch by 10-inch window of cold metal doors
* No visits from family, friends, lawyers, or clergy
* No Mass or Sunday worship service
* Laundry returning with brown stains, pubic hair, and or reeking of ripe urine
* Broken toilets that either wont flush or repeatedly explode in Cells
* Stuck in Cells for 9 days without a shower
* Solitary Confinement for 25 1⁄2 hours or more at a time

Outrageously, there’s more.

**Guards deny them hot water and keep them from attending court. They severely beat, mace, harass, insult, and even sexually assault them.**

Their food is so disgusting and so low in nutrition, that some prisoners are losing their eyesight, their hair, and getting scurvy (from Vitamin C deficiency).

There’s much, much more...all of it horrifying.

And this has been going on for up to a year and a half...in AMERICA.

**They conclude their letter by pleading to be transferred to Guantanamo Bay, Cuba, where the Taliban, al-Qaeda, and ISIS terrorists get better treatment!**

This can’t go on. I won’t allow it.

I’m Larry Klayman, the founder ofstrong Judicial Watch and founder and General Counsel of Freedom Watch.

I’m a former federal prosecutor and trial lawyer who’s fought for the American people for 45 years.

You’ve seen me on cable news outlets and heard me on radio talk shows. I’m proud to say I am the first lawyer to EVER obtain a court ruling that an American president committed a crime when I won my case against Bill Clinton.

I worked closely with Congressman Bob Barr and other impeachment managers to IMPEACH criminal Bill Clinton.

And I SUCCESSFULLY represented the victims of other Clinton scandals, like Filegate, Travelgate, IRS Gate, Chinagate, and many others.

Not to mention that I also enjoined Obama’s corrupt NSA from mass surveillance on hundreds of millions of Americans and killed Obama’s illegal amnesty for over 5 million illegal aliens, a case that went all the way to the Supreme Court!

**I know what it takes to take on federal agencies, politicians, even presidents – AND WIN!**

And now I’m pursuing two class action lawsuits and other important legal actions to get justice for the January 6 Protesters and take on Joe Biden’s rotten regime in court.

**Nobody else is doing what I’m doing in court to get justice for these poor people.**

Patriot, please say a pray for the January 6 Prisoners. Their temptation to despair, to give up, must be enormous.

[Then I beg you to help me fight for them with your very best gift now of $10, $25, $50, $100, or even more. If you’ve given before, please give again. If you can, give more than you’ve ever given to Freedom Watch.](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2ze819ufd4ffg2q90v54nq42pvbsi55ii9edchem8_rp22sh2s8i66or5c3gm6o35cjh2bs)

I can’t do it without you, Patriot.

Thank you for doing whatever you can now.

Sincerely,

Larry Klayman
Founder of both Judicial Watch and Freedom Watch
Current Chairman and General Counsel of Freedom Watch, Inc.

P.S. Patriot, I’m heartbroken after reading that powerful letter from our fellow patriots who are rotting in jail in Washington, D.C. **These are innocent men and women, tortured and abused like they were political prisoners in a Third World dictatorship!**

[Please give what you can right now to help me fight to set them free. $5, $10, $25, $50, even more...whatever you can spare at this very moment. Each dollar counts.](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zbsfjphu6do70nj3sjomg5qqfba1q18a45i4s290_rp22sh2s8i66or5c3gm6o35cjh2bs)

**Free the January 6 Protestors!
**
Right now, un-American politicians and corrupt members of the Department of Justice are keeping innocent Americans in jail without due process...they’re often abused and beaten...they’re blocked from seeing their wives and children...and kept from seeing their lawyers and clergy!

At least one January 6 protestor has already died.

And another protester, a patriot grandma with cancer, just finished serving 60 days in federal prison for a crime she didn’t commit.

[But there’s something you can do about it ...you can donate immediately to Freedom Watch’s critically important lawsuit to HELP FREE the rest of these persecuted patriots with your crucial gift today.](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zh7eoa9ab071r37ks506ml9c3jbjtgdmn6lfncag_rp22sh2s8i66or5c3gm6o35cjh2bs)

This can’t go on. I won’t allow it.

I’m a former federal prosecutor and trial lawyer who’s fought for the American people for 45 years.

You’ve seen me on cable news outlets and heard me on radio talk shows. I’m proud to say I am the first lawyer to EVER obtain a court ruling that an American president committed a crime when I won my case against Bill Clinton.

**Nobody else is doing what I’m doing in court to get justice for these poor people.**

clean_body: Think of it a little like this... | | Peter, The 2022 Election is 24 days away... so think about it like this: We have four 6-day “quarters” left in the game... and to win this thing, we’ve got to mobilize every tool at our disposal. You and I both know: this campaign has attracted huge momentum and support over the past few months... but we simply don’t have the deep pockets that Josh Shapiro and his cabal of Far-Left mega donors do. Our message is strong enough to carry us most of the way, but we still need to amplify it over the next 24 days to every undecided voter in the state of Pennsylvania. This is a 2-point race, Peter. Every single thing we do from now to the end WILL make a difference. | | | | Thanks, Doug | | | | | | PAID FOR BY FRIENDS OF DOUG MASTRIANO PO Box 138, Fayetteville PA 17222

Katrina is bold, smart, and really knows what life is like for working people in North Dakota.

** Hi ,
------------------------------------------------------------

I'm writing today to let you know that I'm supporting Dr. Katrina Christiansen to represent North Dakota in the US Senate.

As an agricultural engineer, she is set to champion North Dakota’s two biggest economic sectors with an independent voice.

Like many North Dakotans, I’m worried about the future of reproductive freedom in our country. | | Just weeks ago, the Senate had the opportunity to do something big: end anonymity for big dollar donors and dark money groups attempting to sway our elections. This was the biggest opportunity to end the days of _Citizens United_ protecting shady donors and corporations. Unfortunately, it should come as no surprise that Republicans BLOCKED it from moving forward. It's very simple: I believe that the American people should decide elections, not the wealthy and well-connected. **_Citizens United_****was a historic mistake – and multinational companies worth billions shouldn't be allowed to endlessly spend their dark money on advertising smokescreens that are skewing our elections.** But this is the reality we've faced in every election since _Citizens United_ : out-of-control influence from shadowy groups that are hiding their true identities because, if you figured out who was _really_ trying to skew your vote, you would rightly be _extremely_ upset. As with too much in life, we need to follow the money. Who stands to benefit when massive corporations (Big Pharma, Big Oil, and the like) can spend unlimited amounts while hiding what they're doing from the American people? **I've been fighting tooth and nail to get ironclad legislation across the finish line because this cannot go on. Our democracy is at a fragile moment in its history, where influence is being gobbled up by fewer and fewer people spending more and more money.** _Citizens United_ is at the heart of that struggle – and every politician who continues to undermine our efforts to get this right. We _must_ overturn it. **On November 8, Election Day, we have a remarkable opportunity to take arguably our biggest step toward fixing this historic problem.** If Democrats keep the House and win just a few more Senate seats, I believe we'll have a very real chance to get dark money out of our elections. clean_body: | | | | Just weeks ago, the Senate had the opportunity to do something big: end anonymity for big dollar donors and dark money groups attempting to sway our elections. This was the biggest opportunity to end the days of Citizens United protecting shady donors and corporations. Unfortunately, it should come as no surprise that Republicans BLOCKED it from moving forward. It's very simple: I believe that the American people should decide elections, not the wealthy and well-connected. Citizens Unitedwas a historic mistake – and multinational companies worth billions shouldn't be allowed to endlessly spend their dark money on advertising smokescreens that are skewing our elections. But this is the reality we've faced in every election since Citizens United : out-of-control influence from shadowy groups that are hiding their true identities because, if you figured out who was really trying to skew your vote, you would rightly be extremely upset. As with too much in life, we need to follow the money. Who stands to benefit when massive corporations (Big Pharma, Big Oil, and the like) can spend unlimited amounts while hiding what they're doing from the American people? I've been fighting tooth and nail to get ironclad legislation across the finish line because this cannot go on. Our democracy is at a fragile moment in its history, where influence is being gobbled up by fewer and fewer people spending more and more money. Citizens United is at the heart of that struggle – and every politician who continues to undermine our efforts to get this right. We must overturn it. On November 8, Election Day, we have a remarkable opportunity to take arguably our biggest step toward fixing this historic problem. If Democrats keep the House and win just a few more Senate seats, I believe we'll have a very real chance to get dark money out of our elections. The work's already begun. Dear #VALUE!,
**This week a group of Los Angeles council members hit the headlines when they were secretly recorded discussing redistricting.** Some of the language that they used was shocking, their conversation littered with casual racism.

The recording is revealing in another way. It draws back the curtain as a group of politicians try to cut deals. **In a properly functioning democracy, voters are supposed to choose their politicians. In the recording we hear politicians scheming to choose their voters.**

“So what?” you might say. “This is gerrymandering, and it has happened for decades”.
---
|
---
| This was not just a conversation about how to achieve favorable redistricting, however. It sounded to me as if these Los Angeles councilors do not think of voters as individuals, but rather as ethnic groups that almost belonged to politicians.

**As they discussed carving up Los Angeles between them, it was all about what is in it for “us” and our ethnic group, Vs “them” and their ethnic group. **

For most of human history, people were defined in terms of caste, race, class or birth. Then along came the Enlightenment and the American Revolution, and a radically better sort of society emerged.

**In America, everyone was supposed to be an individual in possession of inalienable rights.** Yet here we are listening to progressive politicians in 2022 (the recording was actually made in 2021) talking as if none of that any longer applied.

**The left’s relentless obsession with race is taking America to a profoundly dangerous place.** Far from creating a more equitable society in which everyone has more opportunity, the Progressives will produce an American dystopia in which different groups compete with one another to carve up resources.

**Do we really want to live in an America in which politicians, in the manner of mafia bosses, meet to cut backroom deals for “their” group over anyone else?** Do we want a system in which mediocre political figures are given a free pass for their failings because they represent “us” against “them”?

There is nothing progressive about Progressives. To progress is to advance. **Progressive politicians risk taking America back to a premodern past.**

**To help fight back, we are launching the[Mississippi Leadership Academy.](https://mspolicy.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=60d4052c66b6745831ccdf7c8&id=36429a801d&e=5703353baa) **We will take a cohort of bright young Mississippians from different backgrounds each year and introduce them to the ideas that have made America great.

Those that take part will look at some of the public policy challenges we face in our state and hear from some of our state leaders. **But participants will also consider how free markets and America’s Founding principles have helped forge the most successful country on earth.**

As a conservative think tank, we have had plenty of recent wins helping cut the state income tax and defeating the Biden vaccine mandate. But our most important task is to make certain that the next generation of Mississippians understands and appreciates the principles that have made this country such a success.
---

---
| |
---
Warm regards,

Douglas Carswell
President & CEO

I am so incredibly proud of the man Wes has become. From his challenging teenage years and days at military school, Wes went on to:
* Become the first black Rhodes Scholar in the history of Johns Hopkins University
* Lead soldiers in combat as a U.S. Army Captain serving his country in Afghanistan;
* Launch a small business and lead the nation’s largest poverty-fighting organization;
* Become a caring husband and father (his most important achievements);
* Win the nomination to be our Democratic nominee for Governor of Maryland.

body:
Friend, I just got word from my finance director that we fell $16,486 short of yesterday’s Debate Day goal, so I had to reach out again.
---
**I’ll be honest: I’m worried that missing big goals like this one so close to Election Day will put this seat and our Senate majority at serious risk.** GOP donors have already poured over $30 million into Herschel Walker’s campaign to defeat me, polls show us neck and neck, and we’re running out of time to fight back and pull ahead in these final weeks.
**That’s why we need to make up this shortfall ASAP, so I’m urgently asking:[With all eyes on Georgia to decide Senate control, will you rush $5 or more right now to make sure we have enough critical resources to keep both Georgia and the Senate blue?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/52646722/372943201/-598064402?amounts=250,100,50,25,5&refcode=jtk4518-fr-nd&recurring=0&amount=5&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTEvMS85MDkwMSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlZGFjY2I0OC04OTRjLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThlMDgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=m17diSbn0qU8l1C-6fDoE78cZ4nr3YEEv0J9vSvjkEI=)**
Thank you so much for coming through at such an important moment,
– Rev. Warnock

From: **RW**
Date: Fri, Oct 14, 2022
Subject: Just stepped off the stage
| | |
---
Friend, I just stepped off the debate stage, and I wanted to send a quick note. If you had a chance to tune in, I hope I made you proud up there.
But if you didn’t, here’s what I need you to know: **We’re going to win come Nov. 8, and the GOP knows it.**
That’s why national Republicans from Donald Trump to Mitch McConnell are _scrambling_ – launching baseless attack ads and pouring millions into this race to defeat me.
**Republicans will do (and spend) whatever it takes to win this race. That’s why we can’t take anything for granted – and that means we need to hit our Debate Day goal by midnight tonight. **
**So I’m personally asking one last time, friend:[Will you please donate ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/52646724/372943204/-598064402?amounts=250,100,50,25,5&refcode=jtk4518-fr-nd&recurring=0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTEvMS85MDkwMSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlZGFjY2I0OC04OTRjLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThlMDgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=m17diSbn0qU8l1C-6fDoE78cZ4nr3YEEv0J9vSvjkEI=)****[$5 – or whatever you can right now – to help keep Georgia blue and defend our Democratic Senate majority?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/52646726/372943206/-598064402?amounts=250,100,50,25,5&refcode=jtk4518-fr-nd&recurring=0&amount=5&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTEvMS85MDkwMSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlZGFjY2I0OC04OTRjLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThlMDgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=m17diSbn0qU8l1C-6fDoE78cZ4nr3YEEv0J9vSvjkEI=)**
Election Day is so close – and I believe more than ever that our people-powered movement is strong enough to win. We’ve done it before, and we can do it again. Thank you for your support.

– Rev. Raphael Warnock
**Please read on for a personal message from Sen. Rev. Raphael Warnock:** Friend – thank you. I’m grateful to have grassroots folks like you standing alongside me in our critical fights for justice. Our midterm elections are taking place this November, and I need your help.

With Democrats’ razor-thin majority in the Senate, Republicans have to flip just one seat to retake control – and experts say that I’m the most vulnerable Democratic senator up for reelection. Mitch McConnell and his GOP allies are flooding Georgia with millions to defeat me, and GOP super PACs are smearing me with attack ads. We need to fight back now – but I don't take a dime from corporate PACs, so I'm fully relying on your grassroots support to power this campaign to victory.

If you’re with me in this fight, _[**please donate now to win in Georgia and defend our Democratic Senate majority.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/52646727/372943209/-598064402?amounts=250,100,50,25,5&refcode=jtk4518-fr-nd&recurring=0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTEvMS85MDkwMSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlZGFjY2I0OC04OTRjLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThlMDgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=m17diSbn0qU8l1C-6fDoE78cZ4nr3YEEv0J9vSvjkEI=)_ If you’d like to become one of my TOP supporters and receive exclusive updates from our campaign team, **text “GEORGIA” to 52005.**

Thank you!

name: Team Slotkin
subject: Elissa & her opponent on corporate PAC $
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Elissa Slotkin for Congress
body:
Elissa Slotkin for Congresssecure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq42022?refcode=email20221015&amount=28 [secure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq42022?refcode=email20221015&amount=28]
Team,
With just a few weeks to go until Election Day, we thought we’d talk a little bit about an unsavory aspect of our political system: corporate PAC money.
Like the name suggests, these PACs are operated by corporations. Certain employees and shareholders are allowed to pay into them, and they typically support candidates that align with their business interests.
When Elissa first ran for office, she pledged to never accept a dime from a corporate PAC. It’s a promise she’s stuck to, because she never wants her constituents to have a shadow of a doubt about where her priorities lie.
But it goes further than refusing to take corporate PAC money. Elissa’s also actively trying to get it out of our politics and make our system more transparent.
Earlier this year, she cosponsored the Ban Corporate PACs Act, to eliminate the corrupt influence of corporate money in our system. Beyond that, she signed on to the TRUST in Congress Act and the Ban Conflicted Trading Act, aimed at preventing members of Congress and their spouses from buying and trading stocks while in office – because you shouldn’t be able to use the privileged information you receive as a representative to make money. She also introduced the Cryptocurrency Accountability Act, to require members to disclose any and all cryptocurrency holdings and transactions.
Elissa’s opponent doesn’t see things the same way. During his campaigns for state legislature, he relied primarily on donations from special interests; almost 90% of his funds for those races came from corporations, PACs, and similar groups. He’s had difficulty raising money for his campaign for the new 7th, which has drawn the attention of national Republican super PACs, many of whom are buying millions of dollars of ads to do the talking for him.
The contrast between Elissa and her opponent when it comes to transparency could not be more clear – and with money pouring into the new 7th district, will you chip in to help us prove that you don’t need corporate PAC money to win an election? CRUNCHTIME FOR KEY RACES

Key races like John Fetterman’s in PA are tightening as the far right
pours hundreds of millions into spreading lies about our candidates. It’s
our job to undercut their expensive ads by directly engaging with voters
on the issues that affect their lives.

That’s why Our Revolution is hitting the ground to knock on doors and
hitting the phones to send more than a million calls and texts as part of
our massive GOTV operation.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/7748?t=1012&akid=3549%2E5885482%2Enqm3Nh ][IMG]

As OR Executive Director Joseph Geevarghese said on [ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/7749?t=1013&akid=3549%2E5885482%2Enqm3Nh ]The Jeff Santos
Show on Thursday: “What cuts through the rightwing propaganda, the crime
narrative, etc. is pocketbook issues. Our progressive economic populist
agenda is what resonates — and that’s the message we’re taking directly to
voters.”

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/7748?t=1014&akid=3549%2E5885482%2Enqm3Nh ][IMG]

“People are concerned with putting food on the table and a roof over their
heads, with healthcare and sending their kids to college,” Joseph said.
“With candidates like John Fetterman and Mandela Barnes, we can
authentically say ‘these are progressives that are going to go to the mat
for the policies that will improve your life’.”

We have a chance to send Bernie progressive reinforcements in the Senate,
defeat the far right, and cancel out the influence of corporate Dems like
Manchin and Sinema. With just 24 days to Election Day, let’s do everything
we can right now to clinch wins in these critical races!

John Fetterman and Dr. Oz is getting tighter and Mandela Barnes is in a
dead heat with right-wing extremist Ron Johnson.

We’re raising $300K to power our voter turnout model to mobilize our list
of 413,251 voters in the two states. Our Revolution phone bankers have
already called more than 21,000 voters in PA and Wisconsin!

This is the concrete work that can make the decisive difference in these
tight races. [ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/7593?t=1017&akid=3549%2E5885482%2Enqm3Nh ]Donate to our Swing State Fund today!

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/7748?t=1018&akid=3549%2E5885482%2Enqm3Nh ][IMG]

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/7593?t=1019&akid=3549%2E5885482%2Enqm3Nh ]POWER OUR GOTV MACHINE

Minnesota Attorney General Keith Ellison is one of our strongest
progressive fighters in the country — and he’s in a tough fight for
re-election.

The race is a dead heat as his far-right extremist opponent takes big
money to slander him with an onslaught of ads. But, Keith is ‘The People’s
Lawyer’ and we have people-power on our side to reach voters directly with
the facts.

AG Ellison has had a career of public service — in the State Legislature
and the U.S. Congress. His opponent is a hedge fund lawyer who wants to
criminalize abortion at 6 weeks, defund corporate law enforcement, and gut
consumer protections.

As AG, Keith Ellison put hundreds of thousands of dollars back into the
pockets of Minnesota workers who were victims of wage theft. And, he’s
holding Big Pharma accountable for the damage of the opioid epidemic —
winning hundreds of millions for Minnesota.

When a hedge fund landlord stopped repairing their properties, leaving
families without heat and subject to mold and lead paint, Keith stepped in
to defend Minnesotans.

When we say Keith Ellison is the people’s lawyer, that’s what we mean.
That’s the work Jim Schultz wants to defund.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/7748?t=1022&akid=3549%2E5885482%2Enqm3Nh ][IMG]

Last week, Bernie joined US Reps. Ilhan Omar and Pramila Jayapal to travel
across Minnesota and [ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/7725?t=1023&akid=3549%2E5885482%2Enqm3Nh ]rally support for Keith — and Our Revolution is
going all-out to turnout our 147,000 supporters in the state.

Our Phone Bank Force has already made 42,000 phone calls in Minnesota, and
we’re launching 100,000 texts and postcards to 65,000 households of Our
Revolution members with a simple message:

The choice is clear. While Keith is taking on corporate criminals who are
price-gouging customers and stealing worker wages, his opponent wants to
[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/7750?t=1024&akid=3549%2E5885482%2Enqm3Nh ]defund corporate law enforcement altogether and take away women’s
reproductive rights.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/7748?t=1025&akid=3549%2E5885482%2Enqm3Nh ][IMG]

Doing the people’s work earns you powerful enemies, and Keith is in a
fight to the finish. Can you step up to help re-elect Keith Ellison?

human right and that everyone deserves a living wage.

Oscar currently works combatting Republican attacks on our democracy, and

That’s why Our Revolution is hitting the ground to knock on doors and hitting the phones to send more than a million calls and texts as part of our massive GOTV operation. [ ][IMG] As OR Executive Director Joseph Geevarghese said on [ ]The Jeff Santos Show on Thursday: “What cuts through the rightwing propaganda, the crime narrative, etc. is pocketbook issues. With just 24 days to Election Day, let’s do everything we can right now to clinch wins in these critical races! [ ]SIGN UP TO VOLUNTEER! ★ ★ ★ [ ][IMG] Our work to flip Senate seats couldn’t be more vital — the race between John Fetterman and Dr. Oz is getting tighter and Mandela Barnes is in a dead heat with right-wing extremist Ron Johnson. We’re raising $300K to power our voter turnout model to mobilize our list of 413,251 voters in the two states. Our Revolution phone bankers have already called more than 21,000 voters in PA and Wisconsin! This is the concrete work that can make the decisive difference in these tight races. [ ]Donate to our Swing State Fund today! [ ][IMG] Our research shows that if we connect with each voter 4 times — by phone, text, mail, social media, and door-knocking — we can boost turnout by 11 percent. The stakes couldn’t be higher, and there’s a real danger that many progressive, independent, working-class voters will not be motivated to turn out. [ ]POWER OUR GOTV MACHINE ★ ★ ★ [ ][IMG] ★ ★ ★ [ ][IMG] Minnesota Attorney General Keith Ellison is one of our strongest progressive fighters in the country — and he’s in a tough fight for re-election. The race is a dead heat as his far-right extremist opponent takes big money to slander him with an onslaught of ads. But, Keith is ‘The People’s Lawyer’ and we have people-power on our side to reach voters directly with the facts. AG Ellison has had a career of public service — in the State Legislature and the U.S. Congress. His opponent is a hedge fund lawyer who wants to criminalize abortion at 6 weeks, defund corporate law enforcement, and gut consumer protections. As AG, Keith Ellison put hundreds of thousands of dollars back into the pockets of Minnesota workers who were victims of wage theft. And, he’s holding Big Pharma accountable for the damage of the opioid epidemic — winning hundreds of millions for Minnesota. When a hedge fund landlord stopped repairing their properties, leaving families without heat and subject to mold and lead paint, Keith stepped in to defend Minnesotans. When we say Keith Ellison is the people’s lawyer, that’s what we mean. That’s the work Jim Schultz wants to defund. [ ][IMG] Last week, Bernie joined US Reps. Ilhan Omar and Pramila Jayapal to travel across Minnesota and [ ]rally support for Keith — and Our Revolution is going all-out to turnout our 147,000 supporters in the state. Our Phone Bank Force has already made 42,000 phone calls in Minnesota, and we’re launching 100,000 texts and postcards to 65,000 households of Our Revolution members with a simple message: The choice is clear. While Keith is taking on corporate criminals who are price-gouging customers and stealing worker wages, his opponent wants to [ ]defund corporate law enforcement altogether and take away women’s reproductive rights. [ ][IMG] Doing the people’s work earns you powerful enemies, and Keith is in a fight to the finish. Can you step up to help re-elect Keith Ellison? [ ]VOLUNTEER FOR KEITH ★ ★ ★ [ ][IMG] Our Revolution proudly supports Oscar De Los Santos for the AZ House of Representatives in District 11. Born to working-class immigrant parents, Oscar has dedicated his life and career to public service and progressive values. He knows healthcare is a human right and that everyone deserves a living wage. As a teacher at a low-income school in South Phoenix, he’s been at the frontlines of the fight for better-funded schools and better teacher pay. Oscar has fought for economic justice — and won. He led the passage of a bill that doubled the cash assistance program for low-income families and spearheaded a coalition restoring food assistance for those with felonies. Oscar currently works combatting Republican attacks on our democracy, and now we can help put him in the State House! ★ ★ ★ [ ][IMG] Also in Arizona, we must re-elect Sandra Kennedy and add Lauren Kuby to the little-known but powerful Corporation Commission. Sandra was elected in 2018 after the electric utility APS spent more than $10M to defeat her in 2014 and elect commissioners who voted to raise utility prices, [ ]Marketplace reports. Megan supports hotel workers trying to organize with Unite Here Local 74, [ ]STL Today reports, while Coatar sides with the bosses who are also his donors. “He’s the big-money candidate in the race to replace Reed, who was the big-money candidate before Coatar,” [ ]STL Today writes. “Reed, of course, is headed to a likely federal prison sentence for taking bribes in development deals.” In her time on the board, Megan helped pass a $15 minimum wage bill in the city while Coatar voted against it. As board president, she would strengthen the growing bloc of progressive power in the city that includes the Mayor. That’s why Our Revolution callers have dialed out to more than 25,000 voters in the city and we want to triple that before Election Day. [ ]Sign-up to volunteer today! ★ ★ ★ [ ][IMG] Progressives like Rep. Cori Bush and Rashida Tlaib asked Our Revolution members to help send reinforcements to grow progressive power in the House — and that’s exactly what we’re doing! The Washington Post says our movement is on track to dramatically expand the ranks of progressives in the House with Our Revolution-endorsed candidates like Greg Casar, Maxwell Frost, Summer Lee, and other primary winners likely to win in the general election. We’re not just playing it safe — our volunteers are working to win priority competitive races for progressives including Jamie McLeod-Skinner in Oregon’s 5th District and Michelle Vallejo in Texas’ 15th! [ ][IMG] US Senate candidate Mandela Barnes rallied with us Thursday in Milwaukee, WI as we kicked off a nationwide week of action. Thursday’s January 6th hearing revealed more shocking details of the crimes against our democracy, and we’re ratcheting up the pressure for justice. That’s why Our Revolution, Public Citizen, and our coalition will hold more than 70 events for #OurFreedomsOurVote this week with calls to action from civil rights and union leaders, election officials and poll workers, state lawmakers and members of Congress,” [ ]Common Dreams reports. Martin Luther King III, Arndrea Waters King, and US Rep. Raul Grijalva will be joining some of the more than 70 events planned across the country — and you’re invited! [ ][IMG] “The hearings are important, but Congress only has the power to investigate, not to prosecute,” OR Executive Director Joseph Geevarghese said. “That power falls to us, we have the power to hold the insurrectionists accountable.” RSVP TO JOIN AN EVENT NEAR YOU! Oct. 19 - [ ]Harrisburg, PA Oct. 20 - [ ]Wash, D.C. | [ ]Philly, PA | [ ]Phoenix, AZ Oct. 21 - [ ]Manhattan, NYC Oct. 22 - [ ]Dayton, OH * Oct. 23 - [ ]Cincinnati, OH Find more event locations here, or sign up to host one of your own. Our coalition team is on hand to support you every step of the way. [ ]OurFreedomsOurVote.com ★ ★ ★ [ ][IMG] ★ ★ ★ [ ][IMG] RALLY WITH AMAZON WORKERS! Our Revolution: NY Progressive Action Network rallied with Amazon workers this week in Albany as voting runs through Monday to unionize at the #ALB1 location. There were [ ]FIRES in the warehouse last week, and we’re sounding the alarm to stand with workers who are organizing a union to improve health and safety in their workplaces. Also, ONT8 in Moreno Valley, CA filed for their election this week with Amazon Labor. This is about solidarity and showing up, the grassroots doing the groundwork — let's go! ★ ★ ★ [ ][IMG] Our Revolution and our coalition fighting Big Tech notched a win this week with the passage of a House bill to give enforcers more resources to go after anti-competitive mergers and give state AGs more power over which courts they bring antitrust lawsuits in. “This shows there is still a chance for two other key bills to pass later this year,” [ ]CNBC reported on our big push to Bust Big Tech. Let’s keep up the pressure and the momentum! ★ ★ ★ [ ][IMG] [ ]LA Progressive reported this week on the work of Our Revolution and our coalition of climate allies resulting in our Phase 1 victory over Joe Manchin and his Dirty Deal. We were among the first to organize to stop the deal, marshaling our resources and mobilizing thousands of calls to House and Senate offices. Our activists bird-dogged legislators at their offices, rallied on Capitol Hill, pushed the CPC, and ultimately tipped the balance. We know it’s not over, but we’ll be ready when the dirty deal rears its ugly head again. ★ ★ ★ [ ][IMG] Our Revolution: NY Progressive Action Network will hold its first in-person fundraiser party in three years! clean_body: The GOP might get crabby this November | | | Hi Peter – If you know anything about Maryland, you'd know the state is famous for its crabs. Well, we're on a mission to make the GOP crabby this November, especially in Maryland's 1st Congressional District. We are proud to endorse Heather Mizeur for Congress, who is running against the only Maryland Republican U.S. Representative in the state. Heather has spent the past 25 years in public service. She served as a state representative in Annapolis, as a member of AmeriCorps, and for U.S. Senator John Kerry. Now, she lives with her wife on a farm on Maryland's Eastern Shore, where she also is the CEO of a nonprofit aimed at bridging divisions in politics. Seven generations of farming and faith run through Heather's family, and she is the true embodiment of a rural Democrat who understands the need for reform and resources in rural towns. ** If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your secure donation will go through immediately: Thank you for your support in flipping MD-01 and districts across the country for Democrats! – United Rural Democrats HQ United Rural Democrats (URD) is leading the effort to rebuild the Democratic Party in rural America. Friends -
Tonight at midnight, we’ll close the books on one of the final fundraising deadlines of the 2022 campaign for Giffords PAC.

Because here’s the truth:
When we started our work on this issue, most campaigns in swing states and districts thought talking about guns was a nonstarter, a political third rail.
Now, almost a decade later, gun safety is a WINNING issue in races that will determine control of the House and Senate.
And importantly, when we win on the issue of gun safety, it makes passing lifesaving change through Congress even more possible.
So those are the stakes, and why we’re asking. What do you say?

**MEET MIKE:** | A CHAMPION FOR PRINCIPLED LEADERSHIP

Mike learned his love for the Constitution around the family dinner table. Mike's father, Rex Lee, served as Solicitor General under President Ronald Reagan and later as President of Brigham Young University. As a child, Mike attended his father's arguments before the U.S. Supreme Court, giving him a unique understanding of the government from an early age. As an attorney he developed a more complete understanding of why the Constitution is essential to the protection of life, liberty, and property.

After graduating from law school in 1997, he served as a law clerk to Judge Dee Benson of the U.S. District Court for the District of Utah. He then clerked for Judge Samuel A. Alito, Jr., who was serving at that time on the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit Court in Newark, New Jersey. After his second clerkship, he joined the Washington, D.C. office of Sidley & Austin, where he specialized in appellate and Supreme Court litigation. Several years later, Mike was invited to serve as an Assistant U.S. Attorney in Salt Lake City, preparing briefs and arguing cases before the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit. He served as Governor Huntsman's General Counsel and then went to Washington for a one-year clerkship with Justice Alito at the U.S. Supreme Court.

Following his clerkship, Mike joined the Salt Lake office of the Washington, D.C.-based law firm of Howrey LLP. Mike has earned a reputation as an outstanding lawyer based on his sound judgment, writing and courtroom advocacy skills, and thorough understanding of the Constitution. Mike and Sharon have three children and live in Provo, Utah.

In 2020, you put Georgia’s electoral votes in the blue column for the first time in nearly three decades, and you delivered two historic Senate runoff victories last year, electing Jon Ossoff and Raphael Warnock as our state’s first Jewish and Black senators, respectively. Now, I’m asking you for the same level of determination as we work to deliver for Georgians in this time of crisis — and to make history again. We can win the governorship together and create One Georgia, but it will take all of us working our hardest to get it done. If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your split donation to Stacey Abrams and Adam Schiff will go through immediately: | | | Whether you were part of our efforts since the early days of the 2018 campaign or are joining us for the first time, I’m so grateful for your support. A few months from now, we could be preparing to deliver results for the people of Georgia, to expand access to healthcare and to increase opportunity across our state as we begin a new administration in a few months. But I know how much of your time, talent and treasure winning this fight will require. Thank you so much for your support, — Stacey 150 E. **That’s why we set a goal to raise $100,000 before midnight tonight to make sure we have enough critical resources to fight back against GOP spending and win this race – but at this make-or-break moment, we’re falling incredibly short.**

Friends—you can see my uncle’s fingerprints all over the list of
GOP nominees up and down the ballot in key races across the country.

Perhaps nowhere is that more evident than in Ohio, where Silicon Valley
millionaire JD Vance emerged from a pack of other MAGA extremists to grab
Donald Trump’s endorsement and ultimately the nomination for U.S. Senate.

Make no mistake, friends—JD Vance is dangerous. He’s anti-choice,
anti-democracy, and willing to adopt whatever extremist ideology he thinks
will help him win.

Tim Ryan is neck-and-neck with Vance in the polls, but if his campaign
falls short of its fundraising goal, they’ll lose major ground in the
fight to maintain Senate control. [ https://act.timforoh.com/go/26486?t=1015&amount=25&akid=6122%2E3611125%2ECjcUm5 ]Can you pitch in $25 to ensure that
Tim is the next Senator from Ohio?

back into power. If they manage to take back the Senate, our chance to
pass meaningful legislation will go out the window.

Folks, it’s been a tough year. But we have an opportunity
finally to make good on our promise to the American people by delivering
legislation that expands voting rights and protects access to safe and
legal abortion.

That will only happen if we expand our Democratic Senate majority. Whether
or not we do that hinges entirely on what happens in Ohio.

Hi
Friend,
One of
the reasons young people are so attracted to the idea of
socialism is the promised equality of outcomes.

They want
life to be fair for everyone, and for all to have wellness,
happiness, and financial security. But if the end goal of
socialism is "equality", that begs the question: what is
equality? Are equality and liberty consistent one with the other
or are they in conflict?

In this
25-page commentary, "Created Equal", legendary economist and
Hoover fellow Milton Friedman answers these and other questions
in great depth. You'll learn what Thomas Jefferson meant when he
wrote the words "created equal" in the Declaration of
Independence and how the meaning has changed through American
history. You'll see how Friedman brilliantly illustrates
differences between equality of opportunity and equality of
outcome.

With many
today striving to increase government power in the name of a
concept of "equality", Friedman's words still ring true for those
who believe that a society that puts freedom first will end up
with both greater freedom and greater equality.

name: Cheri Beasley
subject: Life is full of surprises
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Cheri Beasley for North Carolina
body:
I never planned it, but my mom taught me the importance of public service.
#

Life is full of surprises. When I was starting out as a public defender, I never imagined that I'd run for judge, win two statewide races, or become the first African American woman to serve as North Carolina’s Chief Justice.
Even just two years ago, running for the U.S. Senate wasn’t something I thought would happen. I never planned it, but my mom taught me the importance of public service. And with Washington failing our families, I knew I had to answer the call again to fight to change the status quo and give people a voice in the Senate.
There have even been surprises in this race. As a daughter of the Civil Rights movement, I never thought I’d see a candidate for U.S. Senate attack the right to vote or believe that free and fair elections are controversial. Yet here we are — my opponent voted to overturn the 2020 election on January 6 and has refused to commit to accepting the results of our own race.
But I think what has been most humbling is just how many people are with us in this fight. So many folks like you have pitched in whatever time and treasure they could afford. It’s because of the overwhelming amount of grassroots support we’ve received that we are in a strong position to flip this seat.

clean_body: Find out what Nikki has been up to this week...| | | | | | | | | | | | TEXAS On Monday, Nikki Haley joined Congresswoman Mayra Flores and Monica De La Cruz in South Texas to energize voters ahead of the upcoming election. These two conservative women are incredible leaders who are fighting to win tough races in Democrat-leaning districts. Congresswoman Mayra Flores is fighting to defend her seat in the TX-34 toss-up race while Monica De La Cruz is running to flip TX-15 red. A great crowd showed up on Monday to rally behind these two rock star candidates. | | | | | | MONICA DE LA CRUZ (TX-15) | | | Republican Monica De La Cruz is fighting for every vote in TX-15, a key pick-up opportunity for the GOP. Monica is an embodiment of the American Dream, putting herself through college, opening her own insurance agency, and now, owning three successful small businesses. That’s why she’ll do everything she can to protect the American Dream for others. Whether it’s supporting stronger border security or working to stop inflation, Monica De La Cruz is prepared to stand for Americans. | | | CONGRESSWOMAN MAYRA FLORES (TX-34) | | | Congresswoman Mayra Flores made history when she flipped her South Texas seat in a special election earlier this year. Now, Democrats are desperate to get it back, and we can’t let them. Mayra’s personal experience makes her a passionate believer in freedom and limited government. At six years old, Mayra Flores traveled from Mexico to the U.S. and became a naturalized American citizen. As the wife of a U.S. Border Patrol agent, Mayra has seen the havoc caused by our broken immigration system. | | She knows that there is no freedom without security, and she is determined to secure our border, restore law and order, and preserve the American Dream. | LAXALT LEADING IN NEVADA New polls in the toss-up Nevada Senate race offer good news. Adam Laxalt holds onto a small lead in nearly every recent poll. Republicans have been eyeing this Nevada Senate seat for years, and 2022 could finally be the year we flip this seat red. Remember — Republicans need to flip just one seat to take back the Senate while holding on to all of the Senate seats currently in Republican hands. Nevada is a true swing state, and this election will come down to the wire. | SMILEY RAKES IN MASSIVE $6M FUNDRAISING HAUL A Republican winning a U.S. Senate seat in Washington may sound like a pipe dream, but Tiffany Smiley is proving that dreams can come true. Smiley shocked Democrats after announcing a massive $6 million fundraising haul in the final FEC quarter before Election Day. With momentum growing for Smiley and shrinking for 30-year liberal incumbent Patty Murray, we need to fight for every vote. | SCHUMER-ALIGNED DEM GROUP DROPS ANOTHER $4M ON ADS IN NC The North Carolina Senate race has been neck and neck for months. Democrats are not giving up yet, with a Chuck Schumer-aligned group pouring another $4 million into the state to try and flip this seat blue. Democrats have now spent more than $10 million to defeat Republican rock star Ted Budd. But Budd is fighting back and pulling out all the stops to keep this crucial Senate seat in the GOP column. Defending this Republican seat is essential if we want to flip the Senate in 24 days. | MARK RONCHETTI BEATS GOV. MICHELLE LUJAN GRISHAM IN FUNDRAISING | | | Incredible news in New Mexico! The numbers are in, and Republican Mark Ronchetti outraised his liberal opponent, incumbent Gov. Michelle Lujan Grisham, in the last reporting period. While incumbent Democrats have been largely winning the fundraising battle, Ronchetti is showing the momentum is on his side. | | Ronchetti scored another win this week with a knock-out performance in the gubernatorial debate. | HOUSE FORECAST | | With Biden’s approval rating continuing to falter and inflation still sky-high, forecasts favor Republicans winning back the House. That said, some key pick-up races could come down to just a handful of votes. We cannot forget when Rep. Miller-Meeks won her seat by just six votes in 2020, proving just how important every last get-out-the-vote effort is. We can’t throw in the towel. We have just 24 days left to give it everything we’ve got and take back our majorities. | | | RALLY WITH GEN. DON BOLDUC Nikki Haley is coming back to New Hampshire! She’ll be rallying alongside Gen. Throughout my time in office, I’ve been able to make a _real_ difference for working families both in New York and beyond, but my fight isn’t over yet. That’s why I’m running for re-election, and I’m counting on your support.

**But Peter, I’ll be frank: We cannot take anything in this race for granted.** As a Black woman, I learned early in life that nothing is guaranteed.

subject: Help us take the lead
body:
The GOP has surged in the generic Congressional ballot in the last week. | | | [](https://breakingconservativedaily.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=22432bec7f541233c6007cfc2&id=976fb8a656&e=fdefed58de)
---
Peter
Let’s talk seriously here. We’ve crunched the latest numbers regarding our campaign and we’re within striking distance. Let me let you in on what we’re seeing.The GOP has surged in the generic Congressional ballot in the last week. At this point, Republican candidates are favored by 7%. That is a number unheard of. So, when you put that into a Congressional race like mine what does that mean.The “experts” say that our district is D+9. Now, that is under a normal circumstance. With the generic ballot favoring Republicans by 7% you can call us a D+2, which is what any “expert” would consider a toss-up race.This race is 50/50 and could go either way. **It will come down to who has more support during this final stretch.**
[](https://breakingconservativedaily.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=22432bec7f541233c6007cfc2&id=cbc566ad0d&e=fdefed58de)
I will NEVER back down from the fight to defend our freedoms and shared values, [**but I need your help to beat my establishment Democrat opponent.**](https://breakingconservativedaily.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=22432bec7f541233c6007cfc2&id=75415b9c5d&e=fdefed58de) This is a seat that Nancy Pelosi most certainly does not want to give up. My opponent is one of her strongest supporters. In fact, he has voted with her 100% of the time. **Yes, one hundred percent!**
[](https://breakingconservativedaily.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=22432bec7f541233c6007cfc2&id=dae0fd5d24&e=fdefed58de)
At 85 years old, Rep. Pascrell has been in Congress for 26 years. There is no reason that anyone should spend that long in Congress unless they’re on the take. It’s time for new leadership. **Our community has been in decline for MANY years and our Congressman has done nothing but enabled it.** I’ve been a resident of Paterson, NJ all my life. My parents legally immigrated to this country from Ghana, West Africa in the late 80s and sacrificed so much to give us the opportunity to thrive in this great land. I am a first-generation American born in 1989 and I feel deeply that I would be doing a genuine dishonor to my parents by not utilizing the opportunities that I have here in America after all they’ve put on the line to give us the chance at living the American dream.**That’s why I’m running for Congress.**[**In just three short weeks this race will be decided. In a race this close, it’s going to come down to who can get their voters out. 100% of the donations that you send our campaign will go into voter outreach at this critical time. Can I count on your support?**](https://breakingconservativedaily.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=22432bec7f541233c6007cfc2&id=3dfed1ee25&e=fdefed58de)
[](https://breakingconservativedaily.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=22432bec7f541233c6007cfc2&id=844e8bab6b&e=fdefed58de)
Thank you so much for your support. We will absolutely win this!Thank You,Billy Prempeh

| Hi Derek, Congressman Conor Lamb here.

I won’t take up too much of your time, but with only 24 days left before the election, I had to reach out to share with you why I’m backing Chris Deluzio to represent PA-17.

But before I get too ahead of myself: _Chris and his team are trying to raise $50,000 before the end of October, and right now they’re falling behind. Slipping up in the final weeks before the election could cost them everything, so**[is there anything you can chip in right now to help close the gap and bring them closer to hitting their October target?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/52676054/373056921/-863883417?refcode=em_fr_2022.10.15_b2_cl_all&amount=15&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjU0MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyN2JkMDRhNC1jYjRjLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThlMDgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=8lJpQOX3HWUPn8gOCkAEwM4VlN1UkaeLyoagb3ZHVmQ=)**_

Everything is on the line this election, and if Chris’s extreme opponent wins, we know he will stand beside the likes of Doug Mastriano and Kevin McCarthy to **ban abortion nationwide, restrict our voting rights, and ship our jobs overseas to appease his corporate donors.**

**[Derek, we can’t afford to sit this one out. I’m calling on you to step up and join me in supporting Chris in the fight for our common good. If there’s anything you can chip in today to help Chris win, I would appreciate it.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/52676055/373056922/-863883417?refcode=em_fr_2022.10.15_b2_cl_all&amount=15&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjU0MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyN2JkMDRhNC1jYjRjLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThlMDgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=8lJpQOX3HWUPn8gOCkAEwM4VlN1UkaeLyoagb3ZHVmQ=)**

Friend – yesterday, Herschel Walker and I wrapped up our first and only scheduled debate before Election Day.

name: Richard Blumenthal
subject: What I'm up against:
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Blumenthal for Connecticut
body:
[ ](http://salsa4.salsalabs.com/dia/track.jsp?v=2&c=5VY02sUhvKNbacTxJ3cTaf8B6zfSvLpk&url=http%3A%2F%2Frichardblumenthal.com%2F)
I need to be upfront about the stakes of our must-win Senate race, Friend:
I am up against an opponent handpicked by Donald Trump - an opponent who is traveling to fundraise with the disgraced former president at Mar-a-Lago.
I am up against national Republicans and right-wing super PACs, including one that's bombarding the airwaves with attack ads against me.
I am up against one of my final fundraising deadlines of the campaign and facing a $12,396 shortfall.
If we lose this seat, it won't just mean that another Trump-backed extremist is in the Senate. It will also mean that Mitch McConnell has retaken control of the chamber - and that he'll have a radical new colleague to rubber-stamp his disastrous GOP agenda. **It will alter the future for our nation. Right wing ideology will determine national issues from voting rights to reproductive freedom. Leonard Leo and the Federalist Society will further undermine our democracy 's belief in and respect for the rule of law, and our confidence in the objective impartiality of our courts. We simply cannot allow this nightmare scenario to come true. **
With voting rights, women's healthcare, reproductive freedoms, and more on the line, I implore you for your support: **[Please, before my fundraising deadline, will you chip in $5 or more to help me make up this urgent shortfall, keep this seat blue, and protect Democratic control of the Senate?](https://secure.actblue.com/contribute/page/blumenthal-email?refcode=jtk1273-fr-nd&amounts=5,25,50,100,250,500)**
Thank you,
Dick

body:
|
# [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/52669676/373033064/-1752180686?refcode=em-header&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS85MzkwNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5ZmY0MmEzMi1iMjRjLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThlMDgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=TGoAyMFe7SBfu2Aa9p9J0UD06F4ilwcpTXUki-tD4Ss=)
Peter,

As we close in on Election Day, I’ve been spending _a ton_ of time meeting new friends ( and hopefully future constituents!) across Illinois’ 17th District. It’s been a blast, and I wanted to share some highlights from the trail.

It’s busy, exhausting, but I don’t take one second of it for granted. I hope you enjoy the updates, and can’t thank you enough for your ongoing support.

Thanks!

- Eric

---

* * *

Earlier this month, I had my first debate against my opponent, Esther Joy King. It was clear my message resonated with undecided voters in attendance. Meanwhile, King doubled down on her out-of-touch, anti-choice positions.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/52669678/373033066/-396165772?refcode=em-10.15.22-all-a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS85MzkwNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5ZmY0MmEzMi1iMjRjLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThlMDgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=TGoAyMFe7SBfu2Aa9p9J0UD06F4ilwcpTXUki-tD4Ss=)
_On the debate stage in Peoria_
I had the opportunity to meet with Honor Flight of the Quad Cities, a group dedicated to flying our veterans down to Washington, D.C. to see the memorials that honor their sacrifices. It was a privilege to stand alongside these great Americans in East Moline as they arrived home from their trip.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/52669679/373033067/-396165772?refcode=em-10.15.22-all-a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS85MzkwNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5ZmY0MmEzMi1iMjRjLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThlMDgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=TGoAyMFe7SBfu2Aa9p9J0UD06F4ilwcpTXUki-tD4Ss=) [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/52669680/373033068/-396165772?refcode=em-10.15.22-all-a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS85MzkwNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5ZmY0MmEzMi1iMjRjLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThlMDgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=TGoAyMFe7SBfu2Aa9p9J0UD06F4ilwcpTXUki-tD4Ss=)
_Meeting members of Honor Flight of the Quad Cities_
In Rock Island, I joined Illinoisans demanding action to protect reproductive rights, a critical issue at stake in this election. If elected, I will fight for the bodily autonomy of all residents of our district and our country.
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/es-q4-2022??refcode=em-10.15.22-all-a) [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/52669681/373033069/-396165772?refcode=em-10.15.22-all-a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS85MzkwNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5ZmY0MmEzMi1iMjRjLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThlMDgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=TGoAyMFe7SBfu2Aa9p9J0UD06F4ilwcpTXUki-tD4Ss=)
_Supporting reproductive freedom in Rock Island_
Peter, I think traveling across the district and hearing from residents all along the way is one of the most rewarding parts of running a campaign. name: Chrissy Houlahan
subject: A dream for all of us
body:
Derek, at the core of my campaign is a fundamental belief that when we join together
| | |
---
Derek, at the core of my campaign is a fundamental belief that when we join together, we can make a positive impact on the lives of our neighbors. We should not settle for simply trying to restore our economy; rather we should strive to make it even better: more accessible, equitable, and prosperous for every American.

Here’s one way we talk about these issues in our first ad of the cycle, "Dreams."
While I was serving in the Air Force, I had my first child, Molly. I only got six weeks of maternity leave, and there was a six-month waiting list for child care on the base. Serving my country and caring for my daughter at the same time proved difficult, so I had to leave the Air Force. Decades later, it’s a challenge millions of parents still face. Later, as a business leader, I helped to establish a comprehensive paid family and medical leave program for my employees.

From the jump, April Becker and her team devised a plan where she would remain silent on some of the most controversial issues. Whether it be the legitimacy of the 2020 election or a national abortion ban, – which has become a real threat in the past few months – Becker has refused to comment on either.
It’s because **anything Becker would say about protecting our democracy or reproductive rights would shock Nevadans.**
The fact is that when April Becker lost her State Senate election in 2020, she filed _two lawsuits_ to contest the results. It’s a shameful display of how a public servant should never act in our country.
Folks, Becker also started a collector’s hobby in this race: she’s racking up endorsements from some of the most prominent, no exceptions anti-choice groups in the country. And when she was asked about a national abortion ban, she said it would be “unconstitutional.” _This is wrong and Nevada constitutional law experts have said so._
Look, I know I don’t need to go on and write out every issue that April Becker and I disagree on (there’s quite a few) but, what’s most disturbing to me is what I’m about to tell you next.
Even though April Becker is one of the most radical candidates in the country, **the Republican Party has spent over $14 million in attacks against me.**

With less than a month left for us to make a difference in this race, every door we knock, call we make, and dollar we raise will increase our chances of winning tenfold. It’s because anything Becker would say about protecting our democracy or reproductive rights would shock Nevadans. The fact is that when April Becker lost her State Senate election in 2020, she filed two lawsuits to contest the results. It’s a shameful display of how a public servant should never act in our country. Folks, Becker also started a collector’s hobby in this race: she’s racking up endorsements from some of the most prominent, no exceptions anti-choice groups in the country. Friend – I write to you today, not as an actor or a former (fictional) president, but as an American concerned about losing our Democratic Senate majority: **Donald Trump just left Nevada where he held a MAGA rally to defeat Sen. Catherine Cortez Masto (D) in the race that will decide Senate control.**

If Trump tips the scales in favor of his hand-picked extremist, Adam Laxalt (R)– if they defeat Sen. Cortez Masto – then Democrats _will_ lose the Senate and Mitch McConnell _will_ regain his iron grip on power.

| | | Latino communities deserve to be heard year round. Let’s keep up the momentum.

Friend,
**As Hispanic Heritage Month draws to a close, the fight for protecting and advocating for our Latino communities is far from over.**
While we celebrated, honored, and supported our Latino leaders and activists, we also recognized the true progressive power the Latino community holds.
This month we held Hispanic Heritage Month events in-person and online, and continued our work by helping students and people across our Latino communities register to vote.
[You can continue to get involved with us and help our Latino communities even after Hispanic Heritage Month!](https://click.everyaction.com/k/52697689/373072279/-918618390?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNTkcvMS81NjE1OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiZDljY2E1ZS1lMzRjLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThlMDgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=M9ntWcMq5S8FubhN1GRF6GYwQQ5F6dfk4CyJVmlA64Q=&emci=b54dc64a-e14c-ed11-819c-002248258e08&emdi=bd9cca5e-e34c-ed11-819c-002248258e08&ceid=6787172)
We accomplished so much this past month and that wouldn’t have been possible without your support and resilience in making sure the voices in our Latino communities are heard and accounted for.
The work we have done is something to be celebrated but also to be continued throughout the years to come because there’s one thing that’s certain — **Latinos are one of the fastest growing communities in our country.** With each generation there are progressive powerhouses who will stop at nothing to ensure Latino communities are represented in the White House, Congress, and state or local offices.
[Our work isn’t over until we see the justice our Latino communities deserve to see. Get involved and show up for the Latino community!](https://click.everyaction.com/k/52697690/373072280/1810264965?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNTkcvMS81NjE1OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiZDljY2E1ZS1lMzRjLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThlMDgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=M9ntWcMq5S8FubhN1GRF6GYwQQ5F6dfk4CyJVmlA64Q=&emci=b54dc64a-e14c-ed11-819c-002248258e08&emdi=bd9cca5e-e34c-ed11-819c-002248258e08&ceid=6787172)
**It’s up to us to continue this mission of protecting and ensuring basic human rights for Latino communities who helped build the backbone of this nation and have sacrificed so much in order to provide a life of possibility for their families and communities.**
Let’s continue the amazing work and keep celebrating and advocating for our Latino communities.
Gracias para todo,

Natalie Monteiro

clean_body: Even after Hispanic Heritage Month, our work isn't over. | | | Latino communities deserve to be heard year round. Let’s keep up the momentum. | | | Friend, As Hispanic Heritage Month draws to a close, the fight for protecting and advocating for our Latino communities is far from over. While we celebrated, honored, and supported our Latino leaders and activists, we also recognized the true progressive power the Latino community holds. This month we held Hispanic Heritage Month events in-person and online, and continued our work by helping students and people across our Latino communities register to vote. We accomplished so much this past month and that wouldn’t have been possible without your support and resilience in making sure the voices in our Latino communities are heard and accounted for. The work we have done is something to be celebrated but also to be continued throughout the years to come because there’s one thing that’s certain — Latinos are one of the fastest growing communities in our country. With each generation there are progressive powerhouses who will stop at nothing to ensure Latino communities are represented in the White House, Congress, and state or local offices. It’s up to us to continue this mission of protecting and ensuring basic human rights for Latino communities who helped build the backbone of this nation and have sacrificed so much in order to provide a life of possibility for their families and communities. Let’s continue the amazing work and keep celebrating and advocating for our Latino communities. Gracias para todo, Natalie Monteiro Digital Associate NextGen America | NextGen America 268 Bush St. #2919 San Francisco CA 94104-3503 This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com | =

name: Team Fetterman
subject: A real person wrote this email
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Fetterman for PA
body:
#
Derek, can we be real with you for a second?
We understand that a constant stream of emails asking for a contribution to our campaign can sometimes get on your nerves. And that’s okay. Actual human beings write these emails, and honestly, we get it.
_But let us explain why this is so vital._
When we’re asking for your support, we don’t expect every person to give. But we ask because we know that when you can support the cause, _you will_. That’s how this transformative movement works. **It’s a whole lot of people doing their part to make something great.**
**[Right now, the fact is that we’re running behind on an important goal. We need to reach 100K contributions before the FEC deadline on Oct 19 and the only way we can get there is through the support of small-dollar donors like you chipping in whatever they can. If you have the means, can you donate $5 right now? It’ll go a long way.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20221015-2?refcode=em20221015-7745&refcode2=7745_434096_Ctw-CH&akid=7745%2E434096%2ECtw-CH)**
Derek, we’re not exaggerating when we say that most candidates fund their campaigns with the help of corporate PACs and by dedicating hours of their time on the phone asking rich donors for $2,900 donations.
**John is different.** This movement is fueled by online contributions like the ones we’re asking for in this email. With these contributions, we’ve built a powerful campaign that is...
1. Recruiting a historic number of volunteers in all 67 counties across Pennsylvania to make sure that no one is left behind this election.
2. Growing support for key issues like reproductive freedom, marijuana legalization, common sense gun safety, and more.
3. Supporting key Senate campaigns across the country to build our Democratic majority.
4. Uniting our state around the values we hold dear – democracy, equality, fundamental rights, and of course, Sheetz being better than Wawa.

**[There are more than enough people reading this email that we could hit our 100K contribution goal instantly if everyone pitched in. If this movement is the model of what you want in our politics, please donate right now.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20221015-2?refcode=em20221015-7745&refcode2=7745_434096_Ctw-CH&akid=7745%2E434096%2ECtw-CH)**
**[RUSH $5 NOW »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20221015-2?amount=5&refcode=em20221015-7745&refcode2=7745_434096_Ctw-CH&akid=7745%2E434096%2ECtw-CH)**
Thanks for reading,
Team Fetterman

**[Donate](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-emails?refcode=em20221015-7745-footer&t=1&refcode2=7745_434096_Ctw-CH&akid=7745%2E434096%2ECtw-CH)**

body:

This campaign's momentum relies on the power of the people. Which is why I could not be more grateful for grassroots supporters like you, Peter.

But here's the thing: Running a winning campaign in one of the most expensive midterm elections in American history takes a lot of resources. And it's vital we have the resources needed to keep up our momentum until the last ballot is cast on November 8.

The money we raise from these emails fuels our voter engagement, so we can talk to people door-to-door, produce yard signs, and provide volunteers with water, masks, clipboards, and pens.

Can you help me finish this race?
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/52675017/373054661/1144435635?refcode=nw_em_templateheader&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODM5MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4ZDNlODgwZC1jNjRjLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThlMDgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=bs2x4H7hB3vVbSwmh3lLoTZY9QzMe5povgV-iLPIseU=)

Folks,
I believe that our reproductive decisions should be made by us, not by politicians regulating our health care options.
**Mike DeWine disagrees.** When asked if he agrees with an Ohio judge’s analysis and recent ruling that our state constitution protects access to abortion care, his response was**“Of course not.”**
Right now, that judge’s decision has blocked Governor DeWine’s outrageous and extreme abortion ban. But Mike DeWine’s allies have filed an appeal to reinstate the ban. And DeWine isn’t the only one to have expressed his opinion that Republicans should get to legislate health care – multiple Republican judges on the state Supreme Court currently up for reelection opined in March that reproductive freedom isn’t a right.
We can’t count on the Republicans in our state government or the state Supreme Court to protect our rights. So we have to fight back and elect a pro-choice governor for Ohio.
**[As governor, I’ll fight to restore and protect our reproductive freedom, and to enshrine those rights in the state constitution – but I need your help. Please, chip in $5 before our mid-month deadline>> ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/52675018/373054662/-138853854?refcode=nw_em_221015_2_t2&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=&firstname=&lastname=&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=&employer=&occupation=&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODM5MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4ZDNlODgwZC1jNjRjLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThlMDgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=bs2x4H7hB3vVbSwmh3lLoTZY9QzMe5povgV-iLPIseU=)**

I know you've heard from a lot of people about how Catherine Cortez Masto's (D-NV) Senate race is the most important in the country – but with just weeks until the election, I wanted you to hear it from me, too.

[**I am going to do everything in my power to make sure that doesn't happen, which is why I'm emailing. The last time Republicans controlled our democratic institutions – headed by McConnell and the impeached former president – was marked by deception, selfishness and every hindrance of progress possible. This period culminated in an attack on democracy itself, sanctioned by many of those who could be part of the Senate majority if Sen. Cortez Masto loses this seat.
The darkness of those years should serve as a reminder for why our Democratic majority is so crucial – but the hopefulness of recent days should be our clarion call. Sen. Cortez Masto and her Democratic colleagues have helmed historic action on infrastructure, climate change, and lowering prescription drug prices. They confirmed the first Black woman to the Supreme Court. And so much more.
**With hope and hard work, we've accomplished a great deal. But with Sen. Cortez Masto down 1 point in the polls and up against more than $50 million in GOP attacks, she _needs_ our help to win. **
[**Let's help Catherine raise $50,000 before her midnight fundraising deadline. Please split $5 between her campaign and Kirsten Gillibrand's, or whatever you can spare, to save our Democratic majority.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/52698453/373085814/1368145142?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk3723-bu-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTkvMS83MjcyMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5NzFlOGNhOS1lOTRjLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThlMDgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=SuddxzL_feTlbTstyBKGmOe-iFstlC0c0wf_cKuD7pI=)

Do we want to be a country where the very right to bodily autonomy lies in the hands of right-wing extremists? The kind of country where health care and lifesaving medications are so expensive, they are out of reach for countless Americans? The kind of country where outright lies and conspiracies are used to tear down our democracy?
I say _no. No_ to the country that MAGA Republican rule would manifest. No to extremism and attacks on democracy and fundamental rights. **But – and I say this with no exaggeration – this all rides on whether Catherine Cortez Masto wins this battleground Senate race in Nevada.**
Experts from The New York Times to CNN are reporting Catherine is the most vulnerable Democratic senator on the ballot, so we urgently need to do our part to help her win. Martin Sheen

Americans—the other jeopardizes the very foundations upon which our
democracy is built.

I’m supporting Tim Ryan for Senate in Ohio because he recognizes that his
duty as an elected official is to fight on behalf of those he represents.

JD Vance is one of those people—he didn’t create the MAGA movement, but

body:
| | | Friend, I’m sure that you weren’t expecting to hear from me today, but I’m reaching out to you now not as an actor, or a former (fictional) President, but as a concerned fellow American. Before I explain why, **[let me personally ask you to make a matched $5 contribution to my friends at the DSCC to help them hold the Senate majority>>](https://go.dscc.org/go/10363?amount=5&t=4&firstname=&lastname=&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&addr1=&addr2=&city=Cresco&state=Pennsylvania&zip=18326&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&ask=5&amounts=5%2C10%2C25%2C50&code=DPE-FD-20221015-MartinSheen-SheenEmail4-Pros-sl1&refcode=DPE-FD-20221015-MartinSheen-SheenEmail4-Pros-sl1&akid=7663%2E9716520%2EYde55l)**

I’ve been an activist for almost my entire life, and I have to be honest with you -- I can’t ever remember a midterm election with more at stake than this one. And now, with just weeks left to go and some early voting _already starting_ , **we all have a choice to make.**

Will we do everything we can to hold the Democratic Senate majority -- the majority that confirmed Justice Ketanji Brown Jackson to the Supreme Court, passed historic infrastructure and climate change legislation, and achieved the most meaningful gun safety reforms in nearly 30 years? Or will we let Republicans retake power and drag our country backward?

I just talked with the folks over at the DSCC, and they told me they have an emergency fundraising deadline TONIGHT that will go a long way toward deciding which choice we'll make in this election. **They're running short of their must-hit goal, so I agreed to step in and help -- but I can't do it alone.**

**A group of generous donors is QUADRUPLING the next $10,000 contributed to the DSCC to make sure they have the resources to defend our Senate majority. ****[So please, rush $5 _(becomes $20)_ to help us defeat the forces looking to drag us backward >>](https://go.dscc.org/go/10363?amount=5&t=5&firstname=&lastname=&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&addr1=&addr2=&city=Cresco&state=Pennsylvania&zip=18326&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&ask=5&amounts=5%2C10%2C25%2C50&code=DPE-FD-20221015-MartinSheen-SheenEmail4-Pros-sl1&refcode=DPE-FD-20221015-MartinSheen-SheenEmail4-Pros-sl1&akid=7663%2E9716520%2EYde55l)**

Two years ago, together, we saw through the fog of deception, divisiveness, and selfishness that defined the Trump era. We remembered something that is a deep part of our humanity -- and that is that we serve ourselves best when we serve others first.

We can't forget that part of ourselves and go back to the way things were going under Republican rule.

**That's why this election is so important -- not just to me, but for you, too.****[So please: Join me right now and make your matched contribution to defend our Democratic Senate.](https://go.dscc.org/go/10363?amount=5&t=6&firstname=&lastname=&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&addr1=&addr2=&city=Cresco&state=Pennsylvania&zip=18326&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&ask=5&amounts=5%2C10%2C25%2C50&code=DPE-FD-20221015-MartinSheen-SheenEmail4-Pros-sl1&refcode=DPE-FD-20221015-MartinSheen-SheenEmail4-Pros-sl1&akid=7663%2E9716520%2EYde55l)**
