clean_body: | | | Friend, I’m sure that you weren’t expecting to hear from me today, but I’m reaching out to you now not as an actor, or a former (fictional) President, but as a concerned fellow American. Before I explain why, I’ve been an activist for almost my entire life, and I have to be honest with you -- I can’t ever remember a midterm election with more at stake than this one. And now, with just weeks left to go and some early voting already starting , we all have a choice to make. Will we do everything we can to hold the Democratic Senate majority -- the majority that confirmed Justice Ketanji Brown Jackson to the Supreme Court, passed historic infrastructure and climate change legislation, and achieved the most meaningful gun safety reforms in nearly 30 years? Or will we let Republicans retake power and drag our country backward? I just talked with the folks over at the DSCC, and they told me they have an emergency fundraising deadline TONIGHT that will go a long way toward deciding which choice we'll make in this election. They're running short of their must-hit goal, so I agreed to step in and help -- but I can't do it alone. A group of generous donors is QUADRUPLING the next $10,000 contributed to the DSCC to make sure they have the resources to defend our Senate majority. Two years ago, together, we saw through the fog of deception, divisiveness, and selfishness that defined the Trump era. We remembered something that is a deep part of our humanity -- and that is that we serve ourselves best when we serve others first. | | Folks, When I decided to run for Congress in 2017, I wasn’t sure what the future would hold. I knew that I had a calling for public service, and I knew that I wanted to serve my community in the place I called home. What I didn’t know was if I had what it took to win. Friend, I would like to share a little bit of my family’s story and why I’m running to be the first Latina to ever represent Oregon in Congress. I hope you’ll take a moment to read it and then chip in to my campaign and help me make history. Today marks the end of Hispanic Heritage Month, but as a Latina, I reflect daily on the contributions that the Latino community has made to our country. **And I know that millions of people in this country share my story – and my pride. Right now, I want to share the story of my father – a proud Latino man who inspires me every day.** Like many who made the harrowing journey before and after, my father immigrated from Mexico to the United States. Upon his arrival, he worked in the fields picking cotton and tomatoes in the Rio Grande Valley, joining millions of other migrants who sustain our country's agriculture industry. Later in life, he joined the military, and after serving two tours in Vietnam, he earned his U.S. citizenship. After that, he spent three decades as a police officer. Our stories are vast and varied, and no two are ever exactly alike. But in hearing each other's stories, we can sense the familiar. My immigrant father was a field worker, soldier, and police officer, but I know that his story resonates with doctors, teachers, and Members of Congress. As we close out Hispanic Heritage month I hope that we continue uplifting stories and voices from the Latino community every month of the year. I’m running to be the first Latina to represent Oregon in Congress. I’ll fight to protect our community and the issues we care about. **But I need your help to get there.** I’m polling neck-and-neck with my opponent, and experts agree it’s going to be a close race. **[So, I have to ask: Can you please make a contribution to my people-powered campaign and help elect the first Latina to represent Oregon in Congress?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/52696896/373071842/1110132872?refcode=em_eng_2022.10.15_b1_AS_all-nd&amount=10&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85Mzg4OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyNDI1MmU5Mi1lMTRjLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThlMDgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=V9_PXyPfo4jUY-Ft06HSqNNY1RFCqO4SMuWloYtwyII=)** __If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:_ _ | _[$5 »](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/52696899/373071843/1110132872?express_lane=true&amount=5&refcode=em_eng_2022.10.15_b1_AS_all-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85Mzg4OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyNDI1MmU5Mi1lMTRjLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThlMDgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=V9_PXyPfo4jUY-Ft06HSqNNY1RFCqO4SMuWloYtwyII=)_ | _[$10 »](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/52696902/373071844/1110132872?express_lane=true&amount=10&refcode=em_eng_2022.10.15_b1_AS_all-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85Mzg4OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyNDI1MmU5Mi1lMTRjLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThlMDgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=V9_PXyPfo4jUY-Ft06HSqNNY1RFCqO4SMuWloYtwyII=)_

body:
[1]Stacey Abrams for Governor

Derek,

In a moment, I’m going to explain to you why I’m running to become the
next governor of Georgia.

But first, I need your help.
Derek, In less than
2 days, I will step on the stage to debate Brian Kemp for the first time
since 2018. My team set an ambitious goal to raise $500,000 before then to
spread my vision for One Georgia.

[ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/4766?refcode=sa_em_221015_B5_ImRunning_S1_T1_SYA_30open&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=5&amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1002&akid=13213%2E1862389%2E9MpatY ]Derek, Will
you invest $5 right now to expose Kemp? Every cent of your
contribution fuels our efforts to reach voters in this critical stage of
our campaign.

[ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/4766?refcode=sa_em_221015_B5_ImRunning_S1_T1_SYA_30open&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=5&amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1003&akid=13213%2E1862389%2E9MpatY ]DONATE

Throughout my career in public service, I’ve had the opportunity to talk
with Georgians from all walks of life. While I've enjoyed interacting with
and meeting everyone, one family left a lasting impression on me.

I first met Valerie and her two children in 2018 while I visited their
home in a low-income community that politicians rarely visit. She beamed
with pride as she told me both her children are headed to college in the
fall.

While they all acknowledged the challenges it would take for her son and
daughter to pursue their respective careers in criminology and education,
they were willing to sacrifice everything so they could to get a shot at a
better life.

When I asked her what a politician like me could do to make their lives
better, she responded that she just wants better financial aid options for
her children so they stay in school even in times of economic hardship.

Most Georgia families like Valerie and her children are doing everything
right. They are working hard to create a better future for themselves —
and yet they are still just one bad turn away from having to drop out of
school or give up on their dreams. And the truth is Brian Kemp’s cruel
agenda has made it harder for these families to survive — much less
thrive.

I’m running to create One Georgia with a singular belief that everyone is
entitled to opportunity.

Because right now in Georgia, under Brian Kemp, rent is sky high,
inflation has destabilized our economy, and the price of groceries is
increasingly out of reach. And instead of trying to fix these issues, we
have a governor who is focused on political stunts.

As governor, I will wake up every morning with your family, your hopes,
your challenges in mind. And I will fight every day to bring education,
health care, housing and a good living to Georgians in every corner of
this state.

[ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/4766?refcode=sa_em_221015_B5_ImRunning_S1_T1_SYA_30open&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=5&amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1004&akid=13213%2E1862389%2E9MpatY ]But I need your help to get there. Derek,
can you please chip in now to raise
$500,000 before I debate Brian Kemp? Together, we can build One Georgia,
where everyone has the opportunity to thrive.

Let's get it done,

Stacey
